fields.name: Mods
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xBE0AF0 ecl::mod::ValidationSystem::UpdateValidationInfo walks an ls::HashMap<ls::Guid, ecl::mod::ValidationInfo> (keys stride 16, values stride 8) and for each key calls get-or-insert FUN_180BDF170(component, guid), copying each set Optional<bool> into it. macOS names the type ls::HashMap<ls::Guid, ecl::mod::ValidationInfo> (EnsureUniversal at 0x10306339C). Live: bucket array (+0) with 5 buckets, keys (+0x20) and values (+0x30) with capacity 1 / size 1 = one validated mod.

fields.name: PublishedMods
